# [CS037] Allocation Sized by Untrusted Input (untrusted-slice-allocation)

make allocates a slice or map whose size comes from the request.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-789](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/789.html) |
| **OWASP** | A06:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

A client-supplied count such as ?limit=999999999 makes the server allocate gigabytes before any data is read. Clamp the value first.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
n, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("limit"))
items := make([]Item, 0, n)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
n, _ := strconv.Atoi(r.URL.Query().Get("limit"))
n = min(max(n, 0), 100)
items := make([]Item, 0, n)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [untrusted-slice-allocation]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    untrusted-slice-allocation: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore untrusted-slice-allocation -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** untrusted-slice-allocation
```
